onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

block.Description: Id of the block of trial

tone_on_time.Description: Onset time of the cue tone (Tone A or B)

tone_off_time.Description: Offset time of the cue tone (Tone A or B)

action_on_time.Description: Onset time of poking L or R

action_off_time.Description: Offset time of poking L or R

pokeC_on_time.Description: Onset time of the poking C.

pokeC_off_time.Description: Offset time of the poking C. It can be regarded as the onset of the action selection.

reward_on_time.Description: Onset time of the sensor in the pellet dish. The sensor detects the existence of a pellet on the dish.

reward_off_time.Description: Offset time of the sensor in the pellet dish. It was the time when the rat picked up the pellet.

state.Description:
the type of the cue tone presented in i th trial
1: Tone A
2: Tone B

action.Description:
selected action in i th trial
1: Left
2: Right
NaN: Tone B Trial or Error Trial

result.Description:
start_time: onset of start tone
stop_time : end time
result    : Result(Refer to the Discription in 'Result' column)

FirstTrial.Description: ID of the first trial in block

LastTrial.Description: ID of the last trial in block

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.BlockDesign: The 'BlockDesign' table in the NWB file.

BlockDesign.Description: id: running index of blocks; start/stop: first/last trial times; FinishedBlock(1/0), FirstTrial, LastTrial, RewardRule_L, RewardRule_R.
